behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.RelativeWriteKeyOutOfRangeIsPermanentError, RelativeConnector.Write) chooses at run time between status 24 (the invalid key of a write 'beyond the externally defined boundaries of the file', §2002:14.8.47.3 GR29) and 2014+'s status 34 for a relative WRITE whose key is out of range; SR5 is a compile-time rule on what record-name-1 may name (§2002:14.8.47.2 SR5) and does not touch the key or the I-O status. Its behaviour at --std 2002 is shown by suite cases run now at 2002: pb347-write-record-of-no-file, -refmod-record, -subordinate-item refused COBOL1757, l1c37_write_same_record_area PASS (E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out-answer\probes-a-06\batch-2002.txt).
